description: This file implements command-line argument handling for the 'gn' build system, including listing, editing, and managing build arguments, with platform-specific code for Windows and POSIX systems.

methods.name: DoesLineBeginWithComment
methods.description: Checks if a line begins with a comment character after skipping whitespace.

methods.name: BackUpToLineBegin
methods.description: Finds the start offset of the line containing a given offset.

methods.name: StripHashFromLine
methods.description: Removes the '#' character and normalizes whitespace in a comment line.

methods.name: GetContextForValue
methods.description: Retrieves the file location, line number, and preceding comment for a given value.

methods.name: PrintDefaultValueInfo
methods.description: Prints information about a default value, including its origin and comments.

methods.name: PrintArgHelp
methods.description: Prints help information for a build argument, including current and default values.

methods.name: BuildArgJson
methods.description: Builds a JSON representation of a build argument's details.

methods.name: ListArgs
methods.description: Lists build arguments in various formats based on command-line switches.

methods.name: RunEditor
methods.description: Opens a file in the user's preferred editor, platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: EditArgsFile
methods.description: Opens the build arguments file in an editor for editing, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: RunArgs
methods.description: Main entry point for the 'gn args' command, dispatching to list or edit functions.
